requirement.statement: Canonical CtrlFlow example bundles SHALL demonstrate product-specific orchestration capabilities and SHALL execute through the declared product loader and engine.

suite.name: 按产品形态的代表示例

case.then: it SHALL demonstrate non-durable script orchestration and complete without persistent waits

case.when: it crosses a wait or composite boundary and resumes in a fresh engine instance
case.then: it SHALL reuse durable orchestration facts without replaying completed effects

case.given: the canonical BizProcess bundle with TaskSpace
case.when: task results and durable composites advance the process
case.then: it SHALL preserve business result data and technical orchestration facts in their owning domains

case.given: a bundle uses a statement outside its product profile
case.then: the loader SHALL reject it with a stable diagnostic
